meta.name: indiehackers
meta.description: Search Indie Hackers for relevant discussions about bootstrapping, AI tools, SaaS, and solo founders — then draft helpful, authentic responses that position TeamDay naturally. Uses public Firebase RTDB and Algolia APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找相关社区讨论，起草自然回复推广产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在独立开发者社区为产品寻找曝光机会
copy.tagline_en: Find relevant discussions and draft authentic replies to promote your product
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder looking to promote your product in the indie hacker community

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会搜索Indie Hackers社区里关于创业、AI工具、SaaS等讨论，浏览最近帖子，阅读某帖正文和评论，再按社区口吻起草回复（自然提及TeamDay），最后整理成一份参与报告。
howto.when: 当你说要查找Indie Hackers上的相关讨论、想监控群聊机会，或要求起草回复、说“check Indie Hackers”时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜Indie Hackers上关于AI agents的讨论
say.note: 会搜索相关帖子并列出机会。

say.text: 看看Solopreneurs群最近有什么新帖
给这个帖子起草一条回复，自然提一下TeamDay
say.note: 会根据社区风格生成回复草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search Indie Hackers for discussions on bootstrapping, AI tools, SaaS, and solo founders, browse recent posts, read full posts and comments, then draft responses in a peer-like tone (naturally mentioning TeamDay), and compile findings into an engagement report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find Indie Hackers discussions, monitor group opportunities, draft a reply to a thread, or say "check Indie Hackers".

say_en.text: Search Indie Hackers for recent discussions about AI agents.
say_en.note: It will search and list relevant posts.

say_en.text: Show recent posts from the Solopreneurs group.
say_en.note: It will fetch the latest threads.

say_en.text: Draft a reply to this post, naturally mentioning TeamDay.
say_en.note: It will generate a response based on community tone.
